comment: pager.c checkfile() lcase()s the typed name before fruit_from_name() compares it with the fruit by strcmp(). lcase() changes only 'A'-'Z', so the fruit "éclair" (typed as its UTF-8 bytes 0xC3 0xA9 with eight_bit_tty on, so sanitize_name() keeps them) does not match "Éclair" (0xC3 0x89): C finds no entry for it, and then shows the fruit entry for "éclair".
